caption: 'The Plank' near Johnson's Bridge on the Grand Union Canal, the River Soar continues to the left.
history: 'The Plank' near Johnson's Bridge situated over the canal at the bottom of Canal Street, showing the towpath underneath. The brick arch was removed around 1970 and replaced by a concrete structure. The one-armed plank, to the left of the picture, has long since been completely rebuilt and the weir has also been remade.
